1d20-ua-plutonium.Settings.translateMode: «By link»: a pasted 5e.tools link imports the English original, a pasted 1d20.com.ua link imports the Ukrainian translation; Plutonium's own importer stays English. «Always»: every Plutonium import is translated. «Never»: only the paste feature works.
1d20-ua-plutonium.Settings.nameMode.Name: Item names
1d20-ua-plutonium.Settings.nameMode.Hint: Ukrainian only; Ukrainian with the English name in brackets; or keep English names and translate descriptions only. The English name is always kept in the item's flags.
Turn dice like «8к6» in translated text into Foundry inline rolls ([[/r 8d6]]).
1d20-ua-plutonium.Settings.attributionLi: Append a small «Український переклад: 1d20.com.ua» link to each translated description, pointing at that entry on the site.
1d20-ua-plutonium.Settings.baseUrl.Name: Data source URL
1d20-ua-plutonium.Settings.baseUrl.Hint: Where manifest.json lives. Default is the data bundled with the module (modules/1d20-ua-plutonium/data). Set it to https://1d20.com.ua/wp-content/uploads/dnd-data to follow the live site instead; if that cannot be reached, the bundled data is used.
1d20-ua-plutonium.Settings.pasteImport.H: Paste a 5e.tools or 1d20.com.ua link (Ctrl+V) over an actor sheet or the sidebar to import it via Plutonium. Per-client.
1d20-ua-plutonium.Notifications.Plutoniu: Plutonium import API is unavailable — cannot paste-import 5e.tools links. See console (F12) for details.
1d20-ua-plutonium.Notifications.Translat: Could not apply the Ukrainian translation to "{name}". See console (F12).
1d20-ua-plutonium.Notifications.DataUnav: Could not load 1d20.com.ua data for "{type}". See console (F12).
1d20-ua-plutonium.Notifications.SlugNotF: "{slug}" was not found in the 1d20.com.ua {type} data.
1d20-ua-plutonium.Notifications.Original: No Ukrainian data for "{name}" yet — importing the English original.
